checks.check: Searching insrc connections exposes Manage Connections; command links and palette actions open same retained manager state.
checks.evidence: package.json configuration includes a Chat-section markdownDescription containing 'insrc connections' and the link '[Manage Connections](command:insrc.openDataSources)' (package.json:166). All 5 CONNECTION_COMMANDS ids (insrc.openDataSources, insrc.connections.add/edit/test/remove) are declared as palette commands with category 'insrc' (package.json:118-142) and are all registered via registerConnectionCommands against the SAME ConnectionsManagerHost instance in extension.ts:337-339, so a command-link invocation and a palette invocation both call host.open(), which reveals the existing panel if already open (host.ts:92 'if(this.#panel){this.#panel.reveal();return;}') — i.e. same retained state.

checks.check: No/multiple registered roots explicit, actual workbench selected; command args only selection hints validated against fresh daemon state.
checks.evidence: host.open() calls this.#ports.registeredRoots() fresh on every open (host.ts:105) and dispatches {type:'registered-roots', roots} to the model; wiring.ts ignores any command arguments entirely (registerConnectionCommands maps commands to () => host.open(), no args passed through). entry.test.ts:28-30 shows zero roots => listState 'no-repository' with roots []; after adding a second synthetic root and reopening, reads increments to 2 (fresh read each open) and a forged command argument {repoRoot:'/unregistered', scope:'temporary', id:'forged', ticket:'forged'} passed to every command (lines 41-46) has no effect on the retained draft/root, proving args are not trusted.

checks.check: Only extension.ts imports vscode; dedicated connections types instead of unrelated panels/types.ts; preserve live registered command IDs.
checks.evidence: grep for "from 'vscode'" under vscode-plugin/src/*.ts (non-test) returns only extension.ts; connections/host.ts, wiring.ts, types.ts import no vscode module (confirmed by reading each). connections/types.ts defines its own ConnectionIntent/ConnectionPanel/ConnectionRenderView with no dependency on panels/types.ts (grep for ConnectionIntent/ConnectionPanel/ConnectionsManagerHost under src/panels returned no matches). The 5 command IDs in wiring.ts (insrc.openDataSources, insrc.connections.add/edit/test/remove) match package.json's declared commands exactly, and entry.test.ts:15-16 asserts declared command IDs are unique and include every CONNECTION_COMMANDS id.

verdict.reason: All three acceptance checks are objectively satisfied by the code (package.json manifest wiring, wiring.ts argument-ignoring registration, host.ts fresh-root-read-on-open, and the vscode-import/types separation), the required integration test CM-S5-ENTRY-TS exercises exactly what its name claims and passed per the daemon, typecheck passed clean, and the implementation stayed within the connections module + extension.ts activation wiring + package.json manifest — no unrelated surface was touched.
